casual3.custom: Own scene design: on a quiet pebble beach beside a shallow lake, she is playing at skipping flat stones over the water. A knee-up three-quarter frontal view at eye level, her face turned toward the camera. She wears an original sporty swim ensemble: a coral capped-shoulder balconette swim top with a squared centre bridge and a matching high-waisted swim skort with rounded overlapping front panels, fully opaque and securely fitted. Her own right arm reaches forward in the follow-through after releasing one flat stone; her own left hand rests on her left thigh. One knee is lifted onto a low smooth rock as she steps across it, briefly opening the rounded skort panel over the bare upper thigh; the lined inner shorts remain in place. No wardrobe failure, no transparency. One small wheel-shaped bracelet is the only species accessory. The quiet moment of play suits her grounded, sturdy character; no other people, creatures or armor.

casual10.custom: Own scene design: an empty open-air hillside amphitheatre in clear afternoon daylight. She sits sideways on a broad stone step after a long walk, enjoying one orange. A waist-up frontal three-quarter composition at eye level, face clearly visible; her own left elbow stays beside her torso and the left hand cups the orange at waist height, while her own right forearm bends naturally in front of her and her right hand pulls one strip of peel free. Her outfit is an original fitted cobalt-blue halter waistcoat with a deep diamond-shaped neckline, narrow ivory piping and pointed petal-cut hems above the bare midriff, paired with saffron fitted tulip shorts joined to a slim belt by two side tabs. Fully opaque and secure, bare shoulders and arms, no outer layer. She wears one small wheel-shaped bracelet; a round stone lies on the adjacent step as the sole source-inspired object. The scene feels restful and playful, with the warm stone terraces receding behind her; no other people, creatures or armor.
